acceptance: The owner records keep, revert or hold with a reason on this item.
If revert: a pin PR restores the previous validated build and passes review.
If keep: the reason and the date by which evidence must exist are recorded.
context: Not blocked by the canary item: it is a policy call that can be made now.
description: The 18.16.0 pin merged with an owner-attestation line that reused values from a passing run on an earlier head; the check on the merged head had crashed. A correction is posted. A real check on develop is now red on live-quota-fallback-walk, so no releasable evidence exists for the pin that production reviews run on. Options: keep 18.16.0 while the canary failure is diagnosed (reviews keep running on an unvalidated build); revert the pin to the previous validated version; or hold until the diagnosis shows whether the failure is a canary defect. The owner decides.
